svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 8 mm flat bar 20 mm wide, ends rounded to 10 mm radius.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 10 mm holes 228.7 mm apart between centres:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: exactly the distance from the cam shaft centre to the lever pivot,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the crank and the lever's up-arm stay parallel as they turn.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: outboard of the crank and the lever, on their 10 mm pins, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a washer and split pin at each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: measure the cam shaft to lever pivot distance on the built

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: subframe and match the link to it within 0.5 mm.
